examples.chinese: 我要坐電梯，不要走樓梯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào zuò diàntī, bù yào zǒu lóutī.
examples.english: I want to take the elevator, not walk the stairs.

examples.chinese: 為了避免兒童發生意外，家長在樓梯邊裝了安全網。
examples.pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn értóng fāshēng yìwài, jiāzhǎng zài lóutī biān zhuāng le ānquán wǎng.
examples.english: To avoid accidents involving children, the parents installed a safety net beside the stairs.

examples.chinese: 公寓的電梯修復中，請大家改走樓梯。
examples.pinyin: Gōngyù de diàntī xiūfù zhōng, qǐng dàjiā gǎi zǒu lóutī.
examples.english: The apartment elevator is under repair; please everyone take the stairs instead.

items.wordHook: 樓(floor) + 梯(ladder): a ladder between floors → stairs.

examples.chinese: 很多年輕男生愛在書店看汽車雜誌，汽車很貴，他們不一定可以買新車，可是都看得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō niánqīng nánshēng ài zài shūdiàn kàn qìchē zázhì, qìchē hěn guì, tāmen bù yídìng kěyǐ mǎi xīn chē, kěshì dōu kàn de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: Many young men like to read car magazines at bookstores. Cars are expensive and they don’t usually have the money to buy new ones; however, they are very happy just by reading those magazines.

examples.chinese: 這個學期開始，從星期一到星期五我都有華語課，每天從上午八點四十分到中午十二點上課，下午一點寫功課，有時候也跟同學練習說中文。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xuéqí kāishǐ, cóng xīngqí yī dào xīngqí wǔ, wǒ dōu yǒu Huáyǔ kè, měi tiān cóng shàngwǔ bā diǎn sìshí fēn dào zhōngwǔ shí’èr diǎn shàngkè, xiàwǔ yī diǎn xiě gōngkè, yǒushíhou yě gēn tóngxué liànxí shuō Zhōngwén.
examples.english: This semester I have Chinese class from 8:40 a.m. to 12:00 noon, Mondays to Fridays. I start to do my homework at 1:00 p.m., and sometimes I practice speaking Chinese with my classmates.

examples.chinese: 最近感冒的人很多，我的同學國安也感冒了，今天開始發燒了。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn gǎnmào de rén hěn duō, wǒ de tóngxué Guó'ān yě gǎnmào le, jīntiān kāishǐ fāshāo le.
examples.english: Many people got colds lately. My classmate, Guoan, got a cold, too. He started to have a fever today.

items.wordHook: You open (開) the curtain, and the show begins (始): 開始 is 'to start'.

examples.chinese: 聽說這家工廠的工人都很辛苦，可是老闆給的錢不多。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhè jiā gōngchǎng de gōngrén dōu hěn xīnkǔ, kěshì lǎobǎn gěi de qián bù duō.
examples.english: I heard that the workers at this factory all work very hard, but the money the boss gives is not much.

examples.chinese: 老闆今天帶我去參觀了一家工廠。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn jīntiān dài wǒ qù cānguān le yì jiā gōngchǎng.
examples.english: The boss took me to visit a factory today.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠的工作很辛苦，可是錢很多，所以很多人願意做。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng de gōngzuò hěn xīnkǔ, kěshì qián hěn duō, suǒyǐ hěn duō rén yuànyì zuò.
examples.english: The work at that factory is very hard, but the pay is good, so many people are willing to do it.

examples.chinese: A:你怎麼了？看起來很不開心的樣子。 B:唉！工廠發生問題，今天又得加班處理了。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ zěnme le? Kàn qǐlái hěn bù kāixīn de yàngzi. B: Āi! Gōngchǎng fāshēng wèntí, jīntiān yòu děi jiābān chǔlǐ le.
examples.english: A: What's wrong? You look very unhappy. B: Alas! There's a problem at the factory; I have to work overtime again today to deal with it.

examples.chinese: 小龍受不了在那個又熱又髒的工廠工作，只做了三天就離開了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎolóng shòubuliǎo zài nàge yòu rè yòu zāng de gōngchǎng gōngzuò, zhǐ zuò le sān tiān jiù líkāi le.
examples.english: Xiaolong could not bear to work in that hot and dirty factory; he only worked for three days and then left.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠生產的皮鞋、皮帶，不但品質好，價錢也不貴。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng shēngchǎn de píxié, pídài, bùdàn pǐnzhí hǎo, jiàqián yě bù guì.
examples.english: The leather shoes and belts that that factory produces are not only good in quality, but also not expensive in price.

examples.chinese: 這次的水災不僅淹了整條街，好幾家工廠也因為淹水沒辦法生產，真是太糟了！
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de shuǐzāi bùjǐn yān le zhěng tiáo jiē, hǎo jǐ jiā gōngchǎng yě yīnwèi yānshuǐ méi bànfǎ shēngchǎn, zhēn shì tài zāo le!
examples.english: This flooding not only flooded the entire street, but several factories also couldn't produce because of the flooding—it's really too bad!

examples.chinese: 那個工人使用工廠的機器時，不小心發生了意外，流了很多血。
examples.pinyin: Nàge gōngrén shǐyòng gōngchǎng de jīqì shí, bù xiǎoxīn fāshēng le yìwài, liú le hěn duō xiě.
examples.english: When that worker was using the factory machine, an accident happened accidentally, and he bled a lot.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠自從改善了設備以後，生產速度就一天比一天快了。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng zìcóng gǎishàn le shèbèi yǐhòu, shēngchǎn sùdù jiù yī tiān bǐ yī tiān kuài le.
examples.english: Ever since that factory improved its equipment, its production speed has become faster day by day.

examples.chinese: 今天客人跟著小溫去參觀工廠，也試用了新產品，一切安排都令他十分滿意。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kèrén gēnzhe Xiǎo Wēn qù cānguān gōngchǎng, yě shìyòng le xīn chǎnpǐn, yīqiè ānpái dōu lìng tā shífēn mǎnyì.
examples.english: Today the guests followed Xiao Wen to visit the factory and also tried out new products; all the arrangements made him very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠的設備及員工都嚴重缺乏，哪裡有辦法進一步發展？
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng de shèbèi jí yuángōng dōu yánzhòng quēfá, nǎlǐ yǒu bànfǎ jìnyībù fāzhǎn?
examples.english: That factory is severely lacking in both equipment and employees; how could there be any way to develop further?

examples.chinese: 家中的廢車可送到汽車修理工廠回收，多多少少能賣點錢。
examples.pinyin: Jiā zhōng de fèichē kě sòng dào qìchē xiūlǐ gōngchǎng huíshōu, duōduōshǎoshǎo néng mài diǎn qián.
examples.english: The derelict car at home can be sent to an auto repair shop for recycling; you can more or less sell it for some money.

examples.chinese: 工廠排水系統得設計好，以免汙染自然環境。
examples.pinyin: Gōngchǎng pái shuǐ xìtǒng děi shèjì hǎo, yǐmiǎn wūrǎn zìrán huánjìng.
examples.english: The factory's drainage system must be well designed, lest it pollute the natural environment.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠排出的廢氣很毒，附近已經有不少民眾生病了。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng pái chū de fèiqì hěn dú, fùjìn yǐjīng yǒu bùshǎo mínzhòng shēngbìng le.
examples.english: The exhaust fumes emitted by that factory are very poisonous; many people nearby have already gotten sick.

examples.chinese: 我們工廠與那家旅行社有合作關係，廠內員工如果報名他們的旅行團，都可以享受優惠價。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngchǎng yǔ nà jiā lǚxíngshè yǒu hézuò guānxì, chǎng nèi yuángōng rúguǒ bàomíng tāmen de lǚxíngtuán, dōu kěyǐ xiǎngshòu yōuhuì jià.
examples.english: Our factory has a partnership with that travel agency; if employees sign up for their tour group, they can all enjoy a discounted price.

examples.chinese: 你既然把工廠交給他，就得放手讓他去管理。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jìrán bǎ gōngchǎng jiāo gěi tā, jiù děi fàngshǒu ràng tā qù guǎnlǐ.
examples.english: Since you've handed the factory over to him, you must let go and let him manage it.

examples.chinese: 新員工在經過專門的訓練後，都已能使用工廠各種生產機器。
examples.pinyin: Xīn yuángōng zài jīngguò zhuānmén de xùnliàn hòu, dōu yǐ néng shǐyòng gōngchǎng gè zhǒng shēngchǎn jīqì.
examples.english: After receiving specialized training, the new employees are all now able to use the various production machines in the factory.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠排出的黑煙不只氣味難聞，更可怕的是可能對肺部造成傷害。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng pái chū de hēiyān bùzhǐ qìwèi nánwén, gèng kěpà de shì kěnéng duì fèibù zàochéng shānghài.
examples.english: The black smoke emitted by that factory not only smells bad, but even more frighteningly, it may cause harm to the lungs.

examples.chinese: 我們特地到當地的滑雪用品工廠參觀，並進行技術交流。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen tèdì dào dāngdì de huáxuě yòngpǐn gōngchǎng cānguān, bìng jìnxíng jìshù jiāoliú.
examples.english: We specially visited a local ski equipment factory and conducted technical exchanges.

examples.chinese: 自動化工廠不僅使生產速度更快，同時也能保證產品品質。
examples.pinyin: Zìdònghuà gōngchǎng bùjǐn shǐ shēngchǎn sùdù gèng kuài, tóngshí yě néng bǎozhèng chǎnpǐn pǐnzhí.
examples.english: Automated factories not only make production speed faster but also can guarantee product quality.

examples.chinese: 這家工廠使用的大型機械全都是淺綠色的，看起來很有特色。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng shǐyòng de dàxíng jīxiè quán dōu shì qiǎnlǜsè de, kàn qǐlái hěn yǒu tèsè.
examples.english: The large machinery used in this factory is all light green, and looks very distinctive.

examples.chinese: 她在電子工廠上班，難怪拆機器的技術非常熟練。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài diànzǐ gōngchǎng shàngbān, nánguài chāi jīqì de jìshù fēicháng shúliàn.
examples.english: She works at an electronics factory, no wonder her skill in disassembling machines is very proficient.

examples.chinese: 臺灣企業到發展中國家設立工廠，是因為當地的人工便宜。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān qǐyè dào fāzhǎnzhōng guójiā shèlì gōngchǎng, shì yīnwèi dāngdì de réngōng piányi.
examples.english: Taiwanese enterprises set up factories in developing countries because local labor is cheap.

examples.chinese: 在抗議新建工廠的活動中，當地的環保團體聯合起來表達他們的需求。
examples.pinyin: Zài kàngyì xīn jiàn gōngchǎng de huódòng zhōng, dāngdì de huánbǎo tuántǐ liánhé qǐlái biǎodá tāmen de xūqiú.
examples.english: In the protest against the construction of a new factory, local environmental groups united to express their demands.

examples.chinese: 這家工廠奪下了著名品牌產品的製造機會。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng duó xià le zhùmíng pǐnpái chǎnpǐn de zhìzào jīhuì.
examples.english: This factory seized the manufacturing opportunity for a famous brand's products.

examples.chinese: 好，明天見。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo, míngtiān jiàn.
examples.english: Okay, see you tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 燈籠上的小老虎好可愛。
examples.pinyin: Dēnglóng shàng de xiǎo lǎohǔ hǎo kě'ài.
examples.english: The little tiger on the lantern is so lovely.

examples.chinese: 這是我朋友做的，因為他屬虎。妳知道十二生肖嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ péngyou zuò de, yīnwèi tā shǔ hǔ. Nǐ zhīdào shí'èr shēngxiào ma?
examples.english: This is the lantern that my friend made because his Chinese zodiac animal sign is tiger. Do you know the Chinese animal zodiac?

items.wordHook: a 虍(tiger) pelt rests over a 儿(person) → one fierce 虎(tiger).

examples.chinese: 我的頭很疼，你可以幫我去藥房買藥嗎？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de tóu hěn téng, nǐ kěyǐ bāng wǒ qù yàofáng mǎi yào ma?
examples.english: My head hurts a lot; can you help me go to the pharmacy to buy medicine?

examples.chinese: 在夜市買東西的時候，有些人會跟老闆殺價。
examples.pinyin: Zài yèshì mǎi dōngxi de shíhou, yǒuxiē rén huì gēn lǎobǎn shājià.
examples.english: When shopping at the night market, some people will bargain with the vendor.

examples.chinese: 外國人在臺灣生活期間，如果遇到任何問題，都可以打0800-024111，請求協助。那個壞人殺了人，他知道自己錯了，到教堂去請求上帝原諒。
examples.pinyin: 1. Wàiguórén zài Táiwān shēnghuó qījiān, rúguǒ yùdào rènhé wèntí, dōu kěyǐ dǎ 0800-024111, qǐngqiú xiézhù. 2. Nàge huàirén shā le rén, tā zhīdào zìjǐ cuò le, dào jiàotáng qù qǐngqiú Shàngdì yuánliàng.
examples.english: 1. During their time living in Taiwan, if foreigners encounter any problems, they can call 0800-024111 to request assistance. 2. That bad person killed someone; he knew he was wrong and went to church to beg God for forgiveness.

examples.chinese: 那件名牌長裙才兩千元而已，用不著跟老闆殺價。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiàn míngpái chángqún cái liǎngqiān yuán éryǐ, yòngbuzháo gēn lǎobǎn shājià.
examples.english: That brand-name long skirt is only two thousand yuan, that's all; there's no need to haggle with the shopkeeper.

examples.chinese: 自殺或許能令個人不再受到痛苦，但卻把痛苦留給了身邊的人。
examples.pinyin: Zìshā huòxǔ néng lìng gèrén bú zài shòudào tòngkǔ, dàn què bǎ tòngkǔ liú gěi le shēnbiān de rén.
examples.english: Suicide may be able to make the individual no longer suffer pain, but it leaves the pain to the people around them.

examples.chinese: 夏天的時候，芒果冰、西瓜汁的生意好得不得了！
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de shíhou, mángguǒ bīng, xīguā zhī de shēngyì hǎo de bùdéliǎo!
examples.english: In summer, the business of mango shaved ice and watermelon juice is extremely good!

examples.chinese: 你說你昨天吃了五盤芒果冰，太誇張了吧！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shuō nǐ zuótiān chīle wǔ pán mángguǒ bīng, tài kuāzhāng le ba!
examples.english: You say you ate five plates of mango shaved ice yesterday—that's too exaggerated!

examples.chinese: 臺灣的芒果冰好吃得沒話說，連吃過的外國人也十分滿意。A:今年銷售商品的成績比以往差， 大家都說是你的責任。 B:你是我最好的朋友，連你也這麼認為，我就沒話說了。
examples.pinyin: 1. Táiwān de mángguǒ bīng hǎochī de méi huà shuō, lián chī guò de wàiguórén yě shífēn mǎnyì. 2. A: Jīnnián xiāoshòu shāngpǐn de chéngjì bǐ yǐwǎng chà, dàjiā dōu shuō shì nǐ de zérèn. B: Nǐ shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péngyǒu, lián nǐ yě zhème rènwéi, wǒ jiù méi huà shuō le.
examples.english: 1. Taiwan's mango shaved ice is delicious beyond words; even foreigners who have tried it are extremely satisfied. 2. A: This year's product sales performance is worse than before; everyone says it's your responsibility. B: You are my best friend, and even you think so—then I have nothing to say.

examples.chinese: 她很喜歡花，你可以送她一些漂亮的花。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn xǐhuān huā, nǐ kěyǐ sòng tā yìxiē piàoliàng de huā.
examples.english: She likes flowers very much. You can give her some beautiful flowers.

examples.chinese: 窗戶前面有很多花，很漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Chuānghù qiánmiàn yǒu hěn duō huā, hěn piàoliàng.
examples.english: There are many flowers in front of the window. It’s very beautiful.

examples.chinese: 這朵花很好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè duǒ huā hěn hǎokàn.
examples.english: This flower is beautiful.

examples.chinese: 紅色的花、白色的花都很漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Hóngsè de huā, báisè de huā, dōu hěn piàoliang.
examples.english: Red and white flowers are both beautiful.

examples.chinese: 他送我花和一本書。
examples.pinyin: Tā sòng wǒ huā hé yì běn shū.
examples.english: He gave me flowers and a book as presents.

examples.chinese: 我送媽媽一朵花。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ sòng māma yì duǒ huā.
examples.english: I gave mom a flower.

examples.chinese: 我想買一些花和一個大蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yìxiē huā hé yí ge dà dàngāo.
examples.english: I would like to buy her some flowers and a big cake.

items.wordHook: a 艹(grass) transforms with 化(change) into a 花(flower).

examples.chinese: 我覺得「把」的語法很難，造句的時候常弄錯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde “bǎ” de yǔfǎ hěn nán, zàojù de shíhou cháng nòngcuò.
examples.english: I think the grammar of “bǎ” is very difficult; when making sentences, I often get it wrong.

examples.chinese: 這堂語法課的內容比較難，學生有任何問題都可以舉手請教老師。
examples.pinyin: Zhè táng yǔfǎ kè de nèiróng bǐjiào nán, xuéshēng yǒu rènhé wèntí dōu kěyǐ jǔshǒu qǐngjiào lǎoshī.
examples.english: The content of this grammar class is relatively difficult; students can raise their hands to ask the teacher for advice if they have any questions.

examples.chinese: 顏教授對漢語語法有很深入的研究，難怪他的語法課那麼受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Yán jiàoshòu duì Hànyǔ yǔfǎ yǒu hěn shēnrù de yánjiū, nánguài tā de yǔfǎ kè nàme shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: Professor Yan has very profound research on Chinese grammar; no wonder his grammar class is so popular.

examples.chinese: (1) 不少外國人說中文不容易學，除了漢字難寫，聲調、語法也很難。想把中文學好，總而言之就是多聽、多說、多練習。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo wàiguórén shuō Zhōngwén bù róngyì xué, chúle Hànzì nán xiě, shēngdiào, yǔfǎ yě hěn nán. Xiǎng bǎ Zhōngwén xué hǎo, zǒng'éryánzhī jiùshì duō tīng, duō shuō, duō liànxí.
examples.english: Many foreigners say Chinese is not easy to learn; besides Chinese characters being hard to write, tones and grammar are also difficult. To learn Chinese well, in short, it is about listening more, speaking more, and practicing more.

examples.chinese: 剛學的詞和語法最好常使用、多複習，如此才能加深記憶。
examples.pinyin: Gāng xué de cí hé yǔfǎ zuì hǎo cháng shǐyòng, duō fùxí, rúcǐ cái néng jiāshēn jìyì.
examples.english: It's best to frequently use and review more the words and grammar you've just learned—only in this way can you deepen your memory.

examples.chinese: 這項語法不太重要，我賭考試一定不會考。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng yǔfǎ bú tài zhòngyào, wǒ dǔ kǎoshì yídìng bú huì kǎo.
examples.english: This grammar point is not very important; I bet it definitely won't be on the exam.

examples.chinese: 這份文件很急，請你下班以前傳真給對方公司。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn wénjiàn hěn jí, qǐng nǐ xiàbān yǐqián chuánzhēn gěi duìfāng gōngsī.
examples.english: This document is very urgent; please fax it to the other company before you get off work.

examples.chinese: 有張紙卡在傳真機裡，你拿得出來嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yǒu zhāng zhǐ kǎ zài chuánzhēnjī lǐ, nǐ ná de chūlái ma?
examples.english: There's a piece of paper stuck in the fax machine; can you get it out?

examples.chinese: 昨天晚上我發燒，燒到三十九度，那種感覺非常不舒服。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshang wǒ fāshāo, shāo dào sānshíjiǔ dù, nà zhǒng gǎnjué fēicháng bù shūfu.
examples.english: Last night I had a fever that went up to thirty-nine degrees, and that feeling was extremely uncomfortable.

examples.chinese: 愛心服務社社員去安養院陪老人過年，讓老人們感覺相當溫暖。
examples.pinyin: Àixīn fúwùshè shèyuán qù ānyǎngyuàn péi lǎorén guò nián, ràng lǎorénmen gǎnjué xiāngdāng wēnnuǎn.
examples.english: The members of the Love Service Club went to the nursing home to accompany the elderly through the New Year, making the elderly feel quite warm.

examples.chinese: 林明生躺在草地上看星星，他感覺真輕鬆。
examples.pinyin: Lín Míngshēng tǎng zài cǎodì shàng kàn xīngxing, tā gǎnjué zhēn qīngsōng.
examples.english: Lin Mingsheng lies on the grass looking at the stars; he feels truly relaxed.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"第一次約會的時候，林先生感覺(到)自己很緊張。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"這棟公寓除了環境不錯，家具還很新，感覺住起來會很舒服。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Dì yī cì yuēhuì de shíhou, Lín xiānsheng gǎnjué (dào) zìjǐ hěn jǐnzhāng. Zhè dòng gōngyù chúle huánjìng búcuò, jiājù hái hěn xīn, gǎnjué zhù qǐlái huì hěn shūfu.
examples.english: On their first date, Mr. Lin felt that he was very nervous. Besides having a nice environment, this apartment building also has very new furniture; it feels like it would be very comfortable to live in.

examples.chinese: 小時候爺爺常陪我做功課、教我打球和釣魚，現在回想起那段時間，感覺真幸福。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoshíhou yéye cháng péi wǒ zuò gōngkè, jiāo wǒ dǎqiú hé diàoyú, xiànzài huíxiǎng qǐ nà duàn shíjiān, gǎnjué zhēn xìngfú.
examples.english: When I was little, my grandfather often accompanied me to do homework and taught me to play ball and fish; now when I recall that time, I feel truly happy.

examples.chinese: 這部電影是用真實故事拍成的，讓觀眾感覺很真實，也很感動。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng shì yòng zhēnshí gùshì pāi chéng de, ràng guānzhòng gǎnjué hěn zhēnshí, yě hěn gǎndòng.
examples.english: This movie was made based on a real story, making the audience feel it is very real and also very moved.

examples.chinese: 這部愛情電影是根據真實故事拍出來的，看過的人都很有感覺。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù àiqíng diànyǐng shì gēnjù zhēnshí gùshì pāi chūlái de, kànguò de rén dōu hěn yǒu gǎnjué.
examples.english: This romance movie was made according to a true story; everyone who has seen it feels deeply moved.

examples.chinese: 教授的房間堆滿了各種書籍，本來就不大的房間感覺更擠了。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoshòu de fángjiān duī mǎn le gè zhǒng shūjí, běnlái jiù bù dà de fángjiān gǎnjué gèng jǐ le.
examples.english: The professor's room is piled full of all kinds of books; the room, which wasn't big to begin with, feels even more crowded.

examples.chinese: 彩色照片看起來很真實，不過黑白照片給人的感覺也很特別。
examples.pinyin: Cǎisè zhàopiàn kàn qǐlái hěn zhēnshí, bùguò hēibái zhàopiàn gěi rén de gǎnjué yě hěn tèbié.
examples.english: Color photos look very realistic, but black-and-white photos also give people a very special feeling.

examples.chinese: 公司的布告上貼著超市打折活動的廣告，感覺真的很怪。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de bùgào shàng tiēzhe chāoshì dǎzhé huódòng de guǎnggào, gǎnjué zhēn de hěn guài.
examples.english: The company's notice has an ad for a supermarket discount event posted on it; it feels really strange.

examples.chinese: 接觸陌生的事情及環境時，往往令人有點兒不安，這樣的感覺是很自然的。
examples.pinyin: Jiēchù mòshēng de shìqíng jí huánjìng shí, wǎngwǎng lìng rén yǒudiǎnr bù'ān, zhèyàng de gǎnjué shì hěn zìrán de.
examples.english: When coming into contact with unfamiliar things and environments, people often feel a bit uneasy; this feeling is very natural.

examples.chinese: 夏天運動過後，喝杯冰冰涼涼的冷飲，感覺很痛快。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān yùndòng guò hòu, hē bēi bīngbīngliángliáng de lěngyǐn, gǎnjué hěn tòngkuài.
examples.english: After exercising in summer, drinking a glass of ice-cold cold drink feels very refreshing.

examples.chinese: 在戶外的夜景中攝影，以月光當作背景可增加神秘的感覺。
examples.pinyin: Zài hùwài de yèjǐng zhōng shèyǐng, yǐ yuèguāng dāngzuò bèijǐng kě zēngjiā shénmì de gǎnjué.
examples.english: When photographing outdoor night scenes, using moonlight as the background can add a mysterious feeling.

examples.chinese: 週末我帶孩子們去鄉下玩，他們餵小羊吃草，拿饅頭給猴子吃，玩得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ dài háizimen qù xiāngxià wán, tāmen wèi xiǎoyáng chī cǎo, ná mántou gěi hóuzi chī, wán de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: On the weekend, I took the children to the countryside to play; they fed the lambs grass and gave steamed buns to the monkeys to eat, and they had a great time.

examples.chinese: 付完學費，我的獎學金只剩下三千塊，這個月只有吃饅頭過日子了。
examples.pinyin: Fù wán xuéfèi, wǒ de jiǎngxuéjīn zhǐ shèng xià sānqiān kuài, zhège yuè zhǐyǒu chī mántou guò rìzi le.
examples.english: After paying the tuition, I only have 3000 dollars of my scholarship left; this month I can only live on steamed buns.

examples.chinese: 中國南北方的飲食習慣有一些差異，南方人多吃米飯，北方人多吃餃子、饅頭等麵食。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó nánběifāng de yǐnshí xíguàn yǒu yīxiē chāyì, nánfāng rén duō chī mǐfàn, běifāng rén duō chī jiǎozi, mántou děng miànshí.
examples.english: There are some differences in eating habits between northern and southern China: southerners eat more cooked rice, while northerners eat more dumplings, steamed buns, and other wheat-based foods.

items.wordHook: Combining 饅(steamed buns) and 頭(the first): 饅頭 means steamed bun.

examples.chinese: 經理這次願意採用新員工的建議，讓我們都嚇了一跳。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ zhè cì yuànyì cǎiyòng xīn yuángōng de jiànyì, ràng wǒmen dōu xià le yí tiào.
examples.english: The manager is willing to adopt the new employee's suggestion this time, which gave us all a start.

examples.chinese: 企業為了錄用合適的人才，而採用各式各樣的方式。
examples.pinyin: Qǐyè wèile lùyòng héshì de réncái, ér cǎiyòng gè shì gè yàng de fāngshì.
examples.english: Enterprises adopt various methods in order to hire suitable talent.

examples.chinese: 這次畢業典禮，學校打算採用空拍的方式來拍紀念影片。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì bìyè diǎnlǐ, xuéxiào dǎsuàn cǎiyòng kōngpāi de fāngshì lái pāi jìniàn yǐngpiàn.
examples.english: For this graduation ceremony, the school plans to use aerial photography to shoot a commemorative video.

examples.chinese: 自從採用專家提供的方法後，茶葉的產量已增加百分之五十。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng cǎiyòng zhuānjiā tígōng de fāngfǎ hòu, cháyè de chǎnliàng yǐ zēngjiā bǎifēnzhī wǔshí.
examples.english: Since adopting the method provided by experts, the production output of tea leaves has increased by 50 percent.

examples.chinese: 沒有人知道自己的命能有多長， 所以每天都應該好好過日子。不少人相信人的命是被決定的， 誰都改變不了。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu rén zhīdào zìjǐ de mìng néng yǒu duō cháng, suǒyǐ měi tiān dōu yīnggāi hǎohǎo guò rìzi. Bùshǎo rén xiāngxìn rén de mìng shì bèi juédìng de, shéi dōu gǎibiàn bù liǎo.
examples.english: No one knows how long their own life can be, so every day one should live life well. Many people believe that a person's fate is decided, and no one can change it.

examples.chinese: 醫生的工作是讓病人恢復健康，甚至把寶貴的生命救回來，所以我們應該尊敬醫生。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng de gōngzuò shì ràng bìngrén huīfù jiànkāng, shènzhì bǎ bǎoguì de shēngmìng jiù huílái, suǒyǐ wǒmen yīnggāi zūnjìng yīshēng.
examples.english: A doctor's job is to help patients recover their health, and even to save precious life back, so we should respect doctors.

examples.chinese: 救護車開得很快，因為要救人一命。
examples.pinyin: Jiùhùchē kāi de hěn kuài, yīnwèi yào jiù rén yī mìng.
examples.english: The ambulance drove very fast, because it needed to save a person's life.

examples.chinese: 這個紀念堂是為了紀念那些為國家犧牲生命的軍人。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jìniàntáng shì wèile jìniàn nàxiē wèi guójiā xīshēng shēngmìng de jūnrén.
examples.english: This memorial hall is to commemorate those soldiers who sacrificed their lives for the country.

examples.chinese: 強烈颱風快來了，救災中心對民眾發出警告，為了自己的生命安全，絕對別去海邊。小游經常喝了酒還開車回家，太太警告他如果不改掉這個壞習慣，就要跟他離婚。
examples.pinyin: Qiángliè táifēng kuài lái le, jiùzāi zhōngxīn duì mínzhòng fāchū jǐnggào, wèile zìjǐ de shēngmìng ānquán, juéduì bié qù hǎibiān. Xiǎo Yóu jīngcháng hē le jiǔ hái kāichē huí jiā, tàitai jǐnggào tā rúguǒ bù gǎidiào zhège huài xíguàn, jiù yào gēn tā líhūn.
examples.english: A strong typhoon is coming soon; the disaster relief center issued a warning to the public: for your own safety, absolutely do not go to the beach. Xiao You often drives home after drinking; his wife warned him that if he doesn't change this bad habit, she will divorce him.

examples.chinese: 打仗期間，許多軍人為國家犧牲了寶貴的生命，也給家人留下了痛苦的記憶。
examples.pinyin: Dǎzhàng qījiān, xǔduō jūnrén wèi guójiā xīshēngle bǎoguì de shēngmìng, yě gěi jiārén liúxiàle tòngkǔ de jìyì.
examples.english: During the war, many soldiers sacrificed their precious lives for the country, and also left painful memories for their families.

examples.chinese: 博物館裡的東西非常寶貴， 它們具有民族和文化的價值， 沒辦法用錢算清楚的。每個人的生命價值都是一樣的，不應該為了自己的利益而犧牲別人。
examples.pinyin: 1. Bówùguǎn lǐ de dōngxi fēicháng bǎoguì, tāmen jùyǒu mínzú hé wénhuà de jiàzhí, méi bànfǎ yòng qián suàn qīngchu de. 2. Měi gè rén de shēngmìng jiàzhí dōu shì yīyàng de, bù yīnggāi wèile zìjǐ de lìyì ér xīshēng biérén.
examples.english: 1. The things in the museum are very precious; they have ethnic and cultural value and cannot be calculated clearly with money. 2. Everyone's value of life is the same; one should not sacrifice others for one's own interests.

examples.chinese: 誰都無法告訴你生命的意義是什麼，只能自己去尋找答案。
examples.pinyin: Shéi dōu wúfǎ gàosù nǐ shēngmìng de yìyì shì shénme, zhǐ néng zìjǐ qù xúnzhǎo dá'àn.
examples.english: No one is able to tell you what the meaning of life is; you can only search for the answer yourself.

examples.chinese: 理論上，有空氣、水、食物就可以維持生命，但還是得看實際的情況。著名的科學家愛因斯坦（ Àiyīnsītǎn, Albert Einstein）發明了相對論（Theory of Relativity），這個理論對後來的科學研究產生了重大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Lǐlùn shàng, yǒu kōngqì, shuǐ, shíwù jiù kěyǐ wéichí shēngmìng, dàn háishì děi kàn shíjì de qíngkuàng. Zhùmíng de kēxuéjiā Àiyīnsītǎn fāmíng le xiāngduìlùn, zhège lǐlùn duì hòulái de kēxué yánjiū chǎnshēng le zhòngdà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: In theory, with air, water, and food, life can be maintained, but it still depends on the actual situation. The famous scientist Albert Einstein developed the theory of relativity; this theory had a major impact on later scientific research.

examples.chinese: 我們無法決定生命的長度，卻能夠決定生活的品質。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen wúfǎ juédìng shēngmìng de chángdù, què nénggòu juédìng shēnghuó de pǐnzhì.
examples.english: We cannot decide the length of life, but we can decide the quality of life.

examples.chinese: 生命就像海洋一樣，只有勇敢的人們才能抵達海的另一邊。
examples.pinyin: Shēngmìng jiù xiàng hǎiyáng yíyàng, zhǐyǒu yǒnggǎn de rénmen cái néng dǐdá hǎi de lìng yì biān.
examples.english: Life is like the ocean; only brave people can reach the other side of the sea.

examples.chinese: 生命就像一片海洋，有時穩定有時瘋狂。
examples.pinyin: Shēngmìng jiù xiàng yī piàn hǎiyáng, yǒushí wěndìng yǒushí fēngkuáng.
examples.english: Life is like an ocean, sometimes stable and sometimes crazy.

examples.chinese: 那位母親寧可犧牲自己的生命，也要保護孩子的安全。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi mǔqīn nìngkě xīshēng zìjǐ de shēngmìng, yě yào bǎohù háizi de ānquán.
examples.english: That mother would rather sacrifice her own life to protect her child's safety.

examples.chinese: 在古代，國王所說的話是絕對的，也是最高的命令。
examples.pinyin: Zài gǔdài, guówáng suǒ shuō de huà shì juéduì de, yě shì zuì gāo de mìnglìng.
examples.english: In ancient times, what the king said was absolute and also the highest command.

examples.chinese: 國王命下面的人死，那些人就非死不可。
examples.pinyin: Guówáng mìng xiàmiàn de rén sǐ, nàxiē rén jiù fēi sǐ bùkě.
examples.english: If the king ordered the people below to die, those people had no choice but to die.

examples.chinese: 要是你擔心營養不夠的話，吃點兒維他命對身體健康會有幫助的。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ dānxīn yíngyǎng bù gòu de huà, chī diǎnr wéitāmìng duì shēntǐ jiànkāng huì yǒu bāngzhù de.
examples.english: If you're worried about not getting enough nutrition, taking some vitamins will help your health.

examples.chinese: 今天光是整理前院的花草樹木就讓我累得要命，只好明天再整理後院了。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān guāng shì zhěnglǐ qiányuàn de huācǎo shùmù jiù ràng wǒ lèi de yàomìng, zhǐhǎo míngtiān zài zhěnglǐ hòuyuàn le.
examples.english: Today, just tidying up the flowers, plants, and trees in the front yard made me extremely tired, so I'll have to do the backyard tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 開車時不闖紅燈，是為了自己和別人的生命安全。
examples.pinyin: Kāichē shí bù chuǎng hóngdēng, shì wèile zìjǐ hé biérén de shēngmìng ānquán.
examples.english: Not running red lights when driving is for the safety of your own and others' lives.

examples.chinese: 經過這次手術，得了重病的嬰兒終於順利地保住了生命。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò zhè cì shǒushù, dé le zhòngbìng de yīng'ér zhōngyú shùnlì de bǎo zhù le shēngmìng.
examples.english: After this surgery, the seriously ill baby finally had its life successfully protected.

examples.chinese: 在歷史上，每次革命都對社會造成非常大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Zài lìshǐ shàng, měi cì gémìng dōu duì shèhuì zàochéng fēicháng dà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: In history, every revolution has had a very great impact on society.

examples.chinese: 自從開始掉頭髮以後，醫師就建議他每天吃半顆維他命。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng kāishǐ diào tóufa yǐhòu, yīshī jiù jiànyì tā měitiān chī bàn kē wéitāmìng.
examples.english: Ever since he started losing hair, the doctor has suggested he take half a vitamin pill every day.

examples.chinese: 戰爭雖然勝利了，這個國家卻也失去了許多寶貴的生命。
examples.pinyin: Zhànzhēng suīrán shènglì le, zhè ge guójiā què yě shīqù le xǔduō bǎoguì de shēngmìng.
examples.english: Although the war was won, this country also lost many precious lives.

examples.chinese: 他看了歷史電影後，就非常崇拜戰爭中的革命英雄。
examples.pinyin: Tā kàn le lìshǐ diànyǐng hòu, jiù fēicháng chóngbài zhànzhēng zhōng de gémìng yīngxióng.
examples.english: After he watched a historical movie, he greatly adored the revolutionary heroes in the war.

examples.chinese: 她推動學習革命，讓學生主動參與規劃課程。
examples.pinyin: Tā tuīdòng xuéxí gémìng, ràng xuéshēng zhǔdòng cānyǔ guīhuà kèchéng.
examples.english: She promoted a learning revolution, letting students actively participate in planning the curriculum.

examples.chinese: 生命中每一刻都很珍貴，隨時多用點心、多付出，就能令人生更美好。
examples.pinyin: Shēngmìng zhōng měi yī kè dōu hěn zhēnguì, suíshí duō yòng diǎn xīn, duō fùchū, jiù néng lìng rénshēng gèng měihǎo.
examples.english: Every moment in life is precious; always put in a little more effort and give a little more, and you can make life more beautiful.

examples.chinese: 關於生命的意義，每個人的想法都不同。
examples.pinyin: Guānyú shēngmìng de yìyì, měi gè rén de xiǎngfǎ dōu bùtóng.
examples.english: Regarding the meaning of life, everyone's thoughts are different.

examples.chinese: 他不小心摔壞了新買的手機，因此難過得要命。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎoxīn shuāihuài le xīn mǎi de shǒujī, yīncǐ nánguò de yàomìng.
examples.english: He accidentally dropped and broke his newly bought cell phone, so he was extremely upset.

items.wordHook: A 亼(gather) of people bow low in 叩(kowtow) to ask for a 命(life).

examples.chinese: 我沒趕上最後一班公車，這下子只好搭計程車回家了。A:糟了，我不小心把隨身碟弄丟了，資料都存在裡面。 B:這下子我們的期末報告都白做了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ méi gǎnshàng zuìhòu yī bān gōngchē, zhè xiàzi zhǐhǎo dā jìchéngchē huí jiā le. A: Zāo le, wǒ bù xiǎoxīn bǎ suíshēndié nòng diū le, zīliào dōu cún zài lǐmiàn. B: Zhè xiàzi wǒmen de qīmò bàogào dōu bái zuò le.
examples.english: I didn't catch the last bus; now I have no choice but to take a taxi home. A: Oh no, I accidentally lost my USB drive; all the data is stored in it. B: Now all our final report work has been done in vain.

examples.chinese: A:我太糊塗了，忘了把變更後的網路銀行密碼記下來。 B:這下子你得親自去銀行處理了。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ tài hútu le, wàng le bǎ biàngēng hòu de wǎnglù yínháng mìmǎ jì xiàlái. B: Zhè xiàzi nǐ děi qīnzì qù yínháng chǔlǐ le.
examples.english: A: I was too careless and forgot to write down the changed internet banking password. B: Now you'll have to go to the bank in person to deal with it.

items.wordHook: Given 這(this) situation right 下(below) now with suffix 子(son): 這下子 means now, thus.

examples.chinese: 學校蓋了一棟活動中心，學生又多了一個交流、休閒的好場所了。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào gài le yī dòng huódòng zhōngxīn, xuéshēng yòu duō le yī gè jiāoliú, xiūxián de hǎo chǎngsuǒ le.
examples.english: The school has built an activity center; the students now have one more good place for interaction and leisure.

examples.chinese: 小年的夢想就是蓋一棟土地面積六十坪、三層樓高的房子，讓全家人都住在一起。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎonián de mèngxiǎng jiùshì gài yí dòng tǔdì miànjī liùshí píng, sān céng lóu gāo de fángzi, ràng quánjiā rén dōu zhù zài yìqǐ.
examples.english: Xiao Nian's dream is to build a three-story house with a land area of sixty ping, so that the whole family can live together.

items.wordHook: Grass 艹(grass) on a roof covers a house; the 盍(what?) inside asks why. → 蓋(build a house).

examples.chinese: 有一些研究科學的人，對不科學、無法合理解釋的現象都不太相信。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē yánjiū kēxué de rén, duì bù kēxué, wúfǎ hélǐ jiěshì de xiànxiàng dōu bú tài xiāngxìn.
examples.english: Some people who study science do not really believe in unscientific phenomena that cannot be reasonably explained.

examples.chinese: 上帝是不是存在，這是屬於宗教領域的問題，科學家的解釋不一定是正確的。
examples.pinyin: Shàngdì shì bú shì cúnzài, zhè shì shǔyú zōngjiào lǐngyù de wèntí, kēxuéjiā de jiěshì bù yídìng shì zhèngquè de.
examples.english: Whether God exists or not is a question that belongs to the religious field; scientists' explanations are not necessarily correct.

examples.chinese: 科學家早就證明了氣溫的變化對農業生產有不好的影響，可是到目前還找不到解決的好辦法。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā zǎo jiù zhèngmíng le qìwēn de biànhuà duì nóngyè shēngchǎn yǒu bù hǎo de yǐngxiǎng, kěshì dào mùqián hái zhǎo bú dào jiějué de hǎo bànfǎ.
examples.english: Scientists proved long ago that temperature changes have a bad effect on agricultural production, but up to now they still cannot find a good solution.

examples.chinese: 科學家發明了電燈，改變了人類的生活方式，也大大提高了生活品質。網路是很偉大的發明，就算不出門，也能讓人們得到全球各地的訊息。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā fāmíng le diàndēng, gǎibiàn le rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì, yě dàdà tígāo le shēnghuó pǐnzhí. Wǎnglù shì hěn wěidà de fāmíng, jiùsuàn bù chūmén, yě néng ràng rénmen dédào quánqiú gèdì de xùnxí.
examples.english: Scientists invented the electric light, which changed the lifestyle of mankind and also greatly improved the quality of life. The Internet is a great invention; even without going out, it can let people get information from all over the world.

examples.chinese: 到底上帝存在不存在，科學與宗教的觀點不同，說法也不一樣。
examples.pinyin: Dàodǐ Shàngdì cúnzài bù cúnzài, kēxué yǔ zōngjiào de guāndiǎn bùtóng, shuōfǎ yě bù yīyàng.
examples.english: Whether God exists or not, the viewpoints of science and religion are different, and their explanations are also different.

examples.chinese: 這兩家公司在科技方面合作了很多年，也在科學雜誌上發表了共同的研究成果。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng jiā gōngsī zài kējì fāngmiàn hézuò le hěn duō nián, yě zài kēxué zázhì shàng fābiǎo le gòngtóng de yánjiū chéngguǒ.
examples.english: These two companies have cooperated in technology for many years and have also published mutual research results in science magazines.

examples.chinese: 理論上，有空氣、水、食物就可以維持生命，但還是得看實際的情況。著名的科學家愛因斯坦（ Àiyīnsītǎn, Albert Einstein）發明了相對論（Theory of Relativity），這個理論對後來的科學研究產生了重大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Lǐlùn shàng, yǒu kōngqì, shuǐ, shíwù jiù kěyǐ wéichí shēngmìng, dàn háishì děi kàn shíjì de qíngkuàng. Zhùmíng de kēxuéjiā Àiyīnsītǎn fāmíng le xiāngduìlùn, zhège lǐlùn duì hòulái de kēxué yánjiū chǎnshēng le zhòngdà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: In theory, with air, water, and food, life can be maintained, but it still depends on the actual situation. The famous scientist Albert Einstein developed the theory of relativity; this theory had a major impact on later scientific research.

examples.chinese: 月亮上面沒有動物，這是1969年科學的新發現。
examples.pinyin: Yuèliang shàngmiàn méiyǒu dòngwù, zhè shì 1969 nián kēxué de xīn fāxiàn.
examples.english: There are no animals on the moon; this is a new scientific discovery of 1969.

examples.chinese: 語言和科學我都很喜歡。
examples.pinyin: Yǔyán hé kēxué wǒ dōu hěn xǐhuan.
examples.english: I like both language and science.

examples.chinese: 根據目前科學研究的資料，女性與男性在能力、態度和行為等方面的差異都非常小。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù mùqián kēxué yánjiū de zīliào, nǚxìng yǔ nánxìng zài nénglì, tàidù hé xíngwéi děng fāngmiàn de chāyì dōu fēicháng xiǎo.
examples.english: According to current scientific research data, the differences between women and men in aspects such as ability, attitude, and behavior are all very small.

examples.chinese: 路教授最近發表的這套跟人體大腦有關的理論，令其他科學家很感興趣。
examples.pinyin: Lù jiàoshòu zuìjìn fābiǎo de zhè tào gēn réntǐ dànǎo yǒuguān de lǐlùn, lìng qítā kēxuéjiā hěn gǎn xìngqù.
examples.english: This set of theories related to the human brain recently published by Professor Lu has made other scientists very interested.

examples.chinese: 科學家在他的時代所努力的結果，都可能會在未來開花結果。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā zài tā de shídài suǒ nǔlì de jiéguǒ, dōu kěnéng huì zài wèilái kāihuā jiéguǒ.
examples.english: The results of scientists' efforts in their era may all bear fruit in the future.

examples.chinese: 對科學家或藝術家來說，提供他們一個不受限制的工作環境是很重要的。
examples.pinyin: Duì kēxuéjiā huò yìshùjiā lái shuō, tígōng tāmen yī gè bù shòu xiànzhì de gōngzuò huánjìng shì hěn zhòngyào de.
examples.english: For scientists or artists, providing them with a work environment that is not restricted is very important.

examples.chinese: 今天的自然科學課程所介紹的主題是月球的構造。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de zìrán kēxué kèchéng suǒ jièshào de zhǔtí shì yuèqiú de gòuzào.
examples.english: The topic introduced in today's natural science course is the structure of the moon.

items.wordHook: 科學 means science: 科(branch) + 學(study) → studying nature branch by branch.

examples.chinese: 收到帳單的時候得準時去繳費，以免超過時間後得繳更多錢。
examples.pinyin: Shōudào zhàngdān de shíhou děi zhǔnshí qù jiǎofèi, yǐmiǎn chāoguò shíjiān hòu děi jiǎo gèng duō qián.
examples.english: When you receive the bill, you must go pay it on time, so as to avoid having to pay more money after the deadline.

examples.chinese: 吃完飯到櫃臺結帳前，應該先看清楚帳單有沒有錯。
examples.pinyin: Chī wán fàn dào guìtái jiézhàng qián, yīnggāi xiān kàn qīngchu zhàngdān yǒu méiyǒu cuò.
examples.english: After eating, before going to the counter to pay the bill, you should first check clearly whether there are any mistakes on the bill.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳的帳單已經加了服務費了，你不必再給小費。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de zhàngdān yǐjīng jiā le fúwùfèi le, nǐ búbì zài gěi xiǎofèi.
examples.english: This restaurant's bill already includes a service charge; you don't need to give a tip.

examples.chinese: 到別人家做客時不能太隨便，以免發生不愉快的事。
examples.pinyin: Dào biérén jiā zuòkè shí bù néng tài suíbiàn, yǐmiǎn fāshēng bù yúkuài de shì.
examples.english: When you are a guest at someone else’s home, you must not be too casual, so as to avoid unpleasant things happening.

examples.chinese: 練習八百公尺跑步時，教練除了要大家記得自己是跑第幾棒的，並且提醒我們把棒子拿好。
examples.pinyin: Liànxí bābǎi gōngchǐ pǎobù shí, jiàoliàn chúle yào dàjiā jìde zìjǐ shì pǎo dì jǐ bàng de, bìngqiě tíxǐng wǒmen bǎ bàngzi ná hǎo.
examples.english: When practicing the 800-meter run, the coach not only told everyone to remember which leg of the relay they were running, but also reminded us to hold the baton well.

examples.chinese: 除非別人願意，否則你不該強迫其他人全按你的意見做事。
examples.pinyin: Chúfēi biérén yuànyì, fǒuzé nǐ bù gāi qiángpò qítā rén quán àn nǐ de yìjiàn zuòshì.
examples.english: Unless others are willing, otherwise you should not force other people to do everything according to your opinion.

examples.chinese: 坐火車時，一旁的旅客不停地講電話，吵得我受不了。
examples.pinyin: Zuò huǒchē shí, yīpáng de lǚkè bùtíng de jiǎng diànhuà, chǎo de wǒ shòubuliǎo.
examples.english: When I was on the train, the passenger beside me kept talking on the phone, making such a noise that I couldn't stand it.

examples.chinese: 他失業了，但妻子三人卻仍在一旁支持著他，讓他安心了不少。
examples.pinyin: Tā shīyè le, dàn qīzi sān rén què réng zài yīpáng zhīchí zhe tā, ràng tā ānxīn le bùshǎo.
examples.english: He lost his job, but his wife and three children still supported him on the side, which made him feel much more at ease.

examples.chinese: 使用高度技術製造出來的工業生產機器，操作起來往往更有效率。
examples.pinyin: Shǐyòng gāodù jìshù zhìzào chūlái de gōngyè shēngchǎn jīqì, cāozuò qǐlái wǎngwǎng gèng yǒu xiàolǜ.
examples.english: Industrial production machines manufactured using highly advanced technology often operate more efficiently.

examples.chinese: 這座橋對車子的高度有限制，開大車的人要小心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò qiáo duì chēzi de gāodù yǒu xiànzhì, kāi dàchē de rén yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: This bridge has a height restriction for vehicles; those driving large vehicles should be careful.

items.wordHook: a 亻(person) holds 十(ten) fingers up in question → 什(what).
分(divide) + 鐘(clock) → the clock's divisions are minutes.
Combining 可(can) and 惡(bad): 可惡 means detestable, hateful.
Combining 品(article) and 味(taste): 品味 means taste or style.
Combining 堅(hard) and 強(strong): 堅強 means mentally strong.
Combining 尤(especially) and 其(his): 尤其 means especially.
Combining 投(pitch) and 資(wealth): 投資 means invest.
Splashing 氵(water) on the 敫(ancient instrument) arouses its sound → 激(arouse).
A 爿(split wood) plank lies beside the faithful 犬(dog) resting in its peaceful condition → 狀(state).
Combining 祝(wish) and 福(happiness): 祝福 means wish happiness to.
A ripe stalk of golden 禾(grain) curves gracefully while 乃(nǎi) bends like a slender stem with graceful 秀(elegant) beauty.
a 竹(bamboo) flute leans on the 即(prompt) of a doorway → 節(festival).
綠(green) + 色(color) → green.
Presenting an outward 表(form) to 示(show) your true intentions: 表示 means express, to show.
Combining 親(relatives) and 眼(glance): 親眼 means with one's own eyes.
a 雚(heron) takes to the 見(see) tower → here to 觀(observe) the town.
